_comment: Single source of truth for webfonts. build.py reads this to create the assets/fonts/ folders, generate src/css/fonts.css and assets/fonts/MANIFEST.md, and validate everything. Edit here, never in the generated files.

families.terminology: 'Display' is GT Sectra's large-size optical cut (the family also ships GT Sectra and GT Sectra Fine). It is not a weight. The CSS family name is 'GT Sectra Display'; the foundry style name maps straight to a CSS weight: Regular = 400.

faces.used_for: h1 and h2 display headings, the footer email line, and the italic half of the wordmark
Emphasised words inside display headings (<em> within h1/h2), and 'Workflows' in the wordmark

families.terminology: 'Inktrap' is the ink-trapped cut of ABC Whyte, a separate family with notched joins. The CSS family name is 'ABC Whyte Inktrap'; Regular = 400, Medium = 500.

faces.used_for: Lead paragraphs, footer links, the Replay artifacts (chat bubbles, cards, sheet cells), intake-flow answer options
'Vector' in the wordmark, navigation, buttons, h3/h4 subheads, card titles, pillar names, form labels

families.terminology: ABC Whyte is the plain (un-trapped) cut, used for long reading text. The CSS family name is 'ABC Whyte'. Dinamo names the upright 'Regular' and the italic 'Italic'; the italic is the Regular-weight italic, so it maps to 400 italic (folder 400-Regular-Italic). Medium = 500.

faces.used_for: Body copy, case-study prose, service details, legal pages, form input text
<em> in running text (the privacy and terms pages use whole emphasised sentences, kept verbatim)

families.terminology: 'Mono' is GT America's monospaced width subfamily. The CSS family name is 'GT America Mono'; Regular = 400.

faces.used_for: Eyebrow labels, badges, metadata rail, the Replay clock and engineer-view log, step counters, footer colophon
